senses.gloss: (I)--same as धूतपापा: a river in कुशद्वीप. M. १२२. ७१.
(II)--the sacrificial fire-place, a वितस्ति in measure- ment and in appearance like the lips of an elephant. M. २६५. ३४. [page३-040+ २३]
--a sacred river of शल्मलिद्वीप. Vi. II. 4. २८.
--the symbol pertaining to देवी; description of. Br. IV. ४२. १८; ४४. ११.
